Every particle in nature has a corresponding '''antiparticle'''.<ref>{{#cite:Q2489}}</ref>

== Properties ==

Compared to its associated particle, an antiparticle has

* the same mass and lifetime
* the opposite electric charge

<ref>{{#cite:Q2489}}</ref>
